items.title: About
items.content:
Photography in Lynchburg, Virginia

Authentic moments. A cinematic eye. ShutterTrends.

Drawn to light.
Grounded in the moment.

The ShutterTrends perspective

My photography starts with authentic moments: a natural expression, a connection between people, the atmosphere of a place.

I bring a cinematic sensibility to portraits, events and creative photography. Thoughtful light and composition help give those moments a distinct visual mood, without losing the feeling that made them worth capturing.

With a special focus on Lynchburg, Virginia, ShutterTrends is a space for local stories and new creative possibilities.

Start with your idea.

You don't need every detail figured out to get in touch.

Tell me what you would like photographed, where it might take place and any preferred dates. A few notes about the mood or purpose of the photographs are helpful, too.
